title: A proof run attestation from the provider's store, with the signing service's trust root of its day
environment: Files only: the test reads them in process, with no network.
records: The bundle that GitHub's attestations API gave on 2026-10-31 for commit 8bcc0d4c853a274bdf33cf80035a0937a6ad03f4: the proof run of pull request 24, signed by proof-run.yml at refs/pull/24/merge, Rekor entry 3614924958. The public-good Sigstore trust root, trusted_root.json from Sigstore's TUF repository on the same day.
prepare: Nothing: the test reads the file.
reset: Nothing: the test changes only copies in memory.
description: Real evidence for the in-process signature check, so the test proves the check against what the provider keeps, not against a fake of it.

title: The coverage output of the pinned spec check for a small product
environment: Files only: the test reads the file in process, with no Lathe.
records: The machine-readable output of lathe check from Lathe 72ab28b6 (schema 5) for the coverage fixture of the coverage tests at its first commit: the domain FX-LEND with three invariants and the product's constraint FX-VO01-C01; 4 obligations, 4 designed, 2 built, 2 proved. Each kind carries its complexity and each coverage scope its debt.
prepare: Nothing: the test reads the file.
description: Real output of the pinned spec check, so the test proves that the coverage reader reads what that version gives, not a fake of it.

title: A rest-crud project with one fill at each standing
environment: A new temporary folder on the test host, with the stego binary built from the commit under test, the built-in registry, the Go toolchain with GOPROXY=off over the module cache of the job, and the keys of ST-EXT-TD02. No network.
accounts: The service author, who signs with listed-ssh of ST-EXT-TD02.
records: A project from stego init --archetype rest-crud with the collections org-users and org-groups, and the SIGNERS file of ST-EXT-TD02 at its root. Fills, each for rest-api.before_create and org-users unless named: qualified-fill (current evidence, and a sign-off by listed-ssh); stale-fill (evidence and a sign-off by listed-ssh, then a change of one line in policy.go); unsigned-fill (current evidence, no sign-off); unlisted-fill (current evidence, and a sign-off by unlisted-ssh); untested-fill (code and a passing test, no evidence); untested-fill-2 (code and a passing test for org-groups, no evidence); no-tests-fill (code and no _test.go file); other-slot-fill (current evidence and a sign-off by listed-ssh, for rest-api.before_delete). Each fill's code imports only out/slots and the standard library. service.yaml binds no fill until a test binds one.
prepare: Run stego init in the temporary folder, write the fills from the fixture, run stego test, and run stego fill sign with the key named for each fill that needs a sign-off. Then change one line of policy.go in stale-fill.
reset: Remove the temporary folder. Nothing outside it changes.
description: One fill at each qualification standing and for each reason that a fill is not qualified, so that a test can find the one fill that a check misses, by its name.

title: Test signing keys, listed and not listed
environment: Temporary HOME and GNUPGHOME folders on the test host, with ssh-keygen and gpg on the PATH. No hardware key and no network.
accounts: The service author, as the holder of the keys below; STEGO holds no key.
records: listed-ssh: an ed25519 SSH key pair with no passphrase, set as the signing key in the git config of the test HOME (gpg.format ssh, user.signingkey). unlisted-ssh: a second ed25519 SSH key pair. listed-gpg: an ed25519 GPG key in the test keyring. keyring-gpg: a second GPG key in the same keyring. A SIGNERS file that lists listed-ssh in the SSH allowed signers format and listed-gpg in the form that STEGO reads for a GPG key, and that does not list unlisted-ssh or keyring-gpg.
prepare: Make the four keys before the test with ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' and gpg --batch --quick-gen-key in the temporary folders, and write SIGNERS from their public keys. Commit no key to the repository.
reset: Stop the gpg-agent that the test started, and remove the temporary HOME and GNUPGHOME folders.
description: Keys that a person holds, made new for each run, so that a test can sign as a person and show that only a key that SIGNERS lists qualifies a fill.

title: The user-management example service
environment: A checkout of the repository on a CI runner, with the compiler built from it, the repository's registry and the Go toolchain; no database.
records: examples/user-management: a rest-crud declaration with the entities Organization and User, its hand-written fills (admin-creation-policy, audit-logger, check-dependencies, org-name-validator, org-provisioner, rbac-policy, send-welcome, user-change-notifier), go.mod and go.sum, and the committed generated output in out with its record.
prepare: Build the compiler from the same commit, and set STEGO_REGISTRY to the repository's registry.
reset: Nothing: the job runs on a new runner, and git restores the folder.
description: A real service with fills, so that a test can show that the committed output is what the compiler generates now.
